en: I've compared my notes. The scout at my house and that masked swordsman were working together.
Did the threats give it away?
They both wanted to stop your travels. Someone's organizing these attacks.
I was hoping it was a very unfriendly coincidence.
I'm afraid we're dealing with an order, not a few wandering troublemakers.
An order. Does it have a name?
I checked every record I could find.
That's a lot of research for a very short answer.
An organization that leaves no trace is a worrying thing.
Possibly. I can't name them yet, but those attacks weren't accidents.
Then we'll stay ready. Let me know when your notes turn up something we can use.
I will. Until then, look after your companions. Whoever sent those attackers is still out there.
zh-CN: 我比对过笔记了。来我家的探子和那名蒙面剑客，是一伙的。
是他们威胁人的口气太像了？
他们都想阻止你的旅程。有人在安排这些袭击。
我还指望，这只是一次很不友善的巧合。
恐怕我们面对的是一个组织，不是几个四处惹事的家伙。
能找到的记录，我都查过了。
查了这么久，答案倒很简短。
一个不留记录的组织，可不是件好事。
你的归档方式，也让人不太放心。
也许吧。我还叫不出他们的名字，但那些袭击绝不是偶然。
那我们就保持警惕。笔记里若翻出什么有用的，记得告诉我。
我会继续查。在那之前，照顾好伙伴。派来那些袭击者的人，还躲在暗处。
